items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: All I know is that he came to record with me; you mentioned the names.

ctx.x: Yeah. He just died not too long ago.
And other musicians, is this about the time that Bill Trillian came in.

Yeah, somewhere around that time, I don’t know exactly, I wasn’t part of how that happened. All I know is that he came to record with me; you mentioned the names. So the phone kept ringing and I kept recording all those years.
